game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle, a circle of glowing runes: the ruin warden must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Rune Circle.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle: a circle of glowing runes
core_gameplay_loop: In Rune Circle, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Rune Circle. Each round, echo phantoms strike the spirit lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the spirit lantern from echo phantoms in Rune Circle: keep the capacity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: capacity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Rune Circle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Rune Circle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while capacity > 0.
